question: Among the following Sufi saints, whose dargah is located at Ajmer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Moin-Ud-Din Chisti.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sufi Saints **Moi-ud-din Chisti Dargah **is Located in **Ajmer.**
 
• At this Dargah, it is believed that the **person who prays with a pure heart will get his all wishes fulfilled**.
 
• It is one of the most important crusade sites for **Sunni Muslims of India. **
 
• **Khwaja Moin-ud-din Chisti **was the founder of Chishti order of Sufism in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bahauddin Zakariya, **also famous as **Baha-ul-Haq** was a S**unni Muslim scholar saint and poet.**
 
• **Fariduddin Ganjshaka** was a Sunni Muslim and was one of the founding fathers of the **Chishti Sufi order**. 
 
• **Ali Hujwiri **is trusted to have **contributed "notably" to the spread of Islam in South Asia.**
